name: Center Split Transition
description: A central counter and line open into two outward-moving panels.

settings.label: Play on entry
settings.description: Replay the entrance on mount and settings changes. Disable for manually triggered navigation.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default:
A considered space.
A quieter arrival.
settings.description: Demo headline. Line breaks are preserved; custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Caption
settings.default:
Light, texture and room to breathe.
A thoughtful beginning, every time.
settings.description: Demo supporting copy. Custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Canvas
settings.description: Receiving canvas behind the demo image. Visible while the image loads or wherever content leaves the canvas uncovered.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: Base color for the demo headline, supporting copy and credit. The replay action and overlay labels use their own colors.

settings.label: Cover
settings.description: Opaque cover and reveal layer color.

settings.label: Minimum height
settings.description: Minimum receiving area height in pixels. The layout follows its container width.

settings.label: Panel opening
settings.description: Time in milliseconds for the top and bottom panels to open after the line sequence and Covered hold.

settings.label: Navigation cover
settings.description: Outgoing cover duration in milliseconds. Applies to Next scene, cover() and navigate(), not Replay reveal.

settings.label: Covered hold
settings.description: Covered pause in milliseconds after the line sequence, before the panels open. Entry delay applies before the line sequence.

settings.label: Entry delay
settings.description: Initial reveal delay in milliseconds. Navigation cover uses its separate duration.

settings.label: Rise distance
settings.description: Content rise in pixels during opening. Custom content uses a direct data-pt-content child.

settings.label: Motion curve
settings.description: Curve for the two panels opening outward and the incoming content rise. Line drawing, fill and fading keep their own curves.

settings.label: Counter and line sequence
settings.description: Milliseconds scaling the line draw, fill and stretch together. The counter is decorative, not loading progress.

settings.label: Counter and fill
settings.description: Shared color of the counter and progress fill.
